## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.3.0

Milestone 3 adds whole-process campaign measurement and focused attribution for the next TOR optimization candidates. The validated career-choice cache remains the only active gameplay optimization.

### Added

- Profiler-independent whole-process benchmark sessions.
- Process CPU time and normalized CPU percentages.
- Campaign-hours-per-real-minute throughput.
- Allocation-free frame-time recording with average, p50, p95, p99, and exact maximum values.
- Mission counts, GC collection deltas, and managed-memory deltas.
- JSON and one-row CSV benchmark reports.
- Profiling-free baseline and optimized A/B templates.
- Focused direct profiling for `TORCharacterStatsModel.MaxHitpoints`.
- Focused direct profiling for `TORMapVisibilityModel.GetPartySpottingRange`, its settlement predicate, and `TORCommon.FindSettlementsAroundPosition`.
- Focused direct profiling for `TORCompanionsCampaignBehavior.WeeklyTick`.
- A controlled A/B and focused-attribution procedure.

### Preserved

- The exact MVID/signature/IL-gated career-choice cache from v0.2.1.
- Shadow validation, per-ID validation, original-call audits, campaign-instance binding, and automatic fallback.
- Clean Harmony 2.4.2 teardown coverage.
- No AI throttling, simulation throttling, mission cadence changes, native patches, background TaleWorlds access, or serialized optimizer state.

### Important

`settings.json` keeps both profiling and benchmarking disabled for normal gameplay. Use `settings.benchmark-baseline.json` and `settings.benchmark-optimized.json` only for controlled A/B runs. Use `settings.profiler.json` only for focused method attribution.

No new TOR gameplay method is optimized in this release; the new candidates remain observation-only until runtime evidence supports an equivalence-safe patch.
